name: Crude Oil EIA Inventory Reaction Profile
description: Measures how crude oil (CL) moves around the weekly EIA Petroleum Status Report released Wednesdays at 10:30 AM ET. Computes absolute percentage moves at +1, +5, +15, and +30 minutes after the release bar. Outputs: bar chart of average absolute move by horizon, event markers for each release, and a summary statistics table.
source:
# Crude Oil EIA Inventory Report Reaction Profile
# Detects Wednesday 10:30 AM ET releases via day_of_week + time proxy
# Measures absolute % move at +1, +5, +15, +30 minutes after release

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(raw.o, raw.h, raw.l, raw.c, raw.v, raw.oi, raw.s)
close = cont.c

# --- Timestamp extraction (Eastern Time) ---
ts = index()
dow = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)
hour_et = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)
min_et = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)

# --- EIA release bar detection ---
# Wednesday = day_of_week 2 (0=Monday), 10:30 AM ET
is_eia_bar = (dow.value == 2) and (hour_et.value == 10) and (min_et.value == 30)

# --- Forward absolute % moves from release price ---
# close << N gives the close price N bars (minutes) ahead
abs_move_1m = where(is_eia_bar, abs((close << 1) - close) / close)
abs_move_5m = where(is_eia_bar, abs((close << 5) - close) / close)
abs_move_15m = where(is_eia_bar, abs((close << 15) - close) / close)
abs_move_30m = where(is_eia_bar, abs((close << 30) - close) / close)

# --- Signed move for event marker context (direction matters for cards) ---
signed_move_5m = where(is_eia_bar, ((close << 5) - close) / close)
signed_move_30m = where(is_eia_bar, ((close << 30) - close) / close)
release_price = where(is_eia_bar, close)

# --- Output 1: Bar chart — Average absolute move by horizon ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='How Big Is the Typical EIA Reaction?',
    category='EIA Reaction',
    y_axis_label='Avg Absolute Move',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    x_axis_label='Minutes After Release',
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 min', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5 min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+15 min', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+30 min', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(abs_move_1m, abs_move_5m, abs_move_15m, abs_move_30m))

# --- Output 2: Event markers for each EIA release ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EIA Inventory Release',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='5-Min Move', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='30-Min Move', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Release Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(signed_move_5m, signed_move_30m, release_price, is_eia_bar)

# --- Output 3: Summary statistics table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='EIA Reaction',
    order=2,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EIA Release Reaction Statistics',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Median', 'Mean', 'Max', 'Count'],
        col_headers=['+1 min', '+5 min', '+15 min', '+30 min'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    )
)(abs_move_1m, abs_move_5m, abs_move_15m, abs_move_30m)
